workflow.description: Backs up the data before the suite changes it, first in PrimeFaces and then in SmartClient, so that the final restore has something to put back and both UIs' backup screens are proved to work.

automation.description: Signs in as admin in PrimeFaces (tablet UX/UI), clears the completed jobs list and backs up the data, checking the backup appears in the list.

interaction.name: Clear the completed jobs list
interaction.description: Deletes the completed jobs so that later job rows can be told from earlier ones, and checks the list is empty.

method.comment: The suite waits for its jobs (backup, test data, restore) by their rows in the completed jobs list. Every restore leaves a RestoreJob row in the data it restores, so without this the restore's own row could not be told from an earlier one. The list is job history only.

interaction.name: Back up the data before the suite (PrimeFaces)
interaction.description: Opens Data Maintenance, starts a full backup without redaction, waits for the Backup job to complete in the Jobs list, and checks the backup is listed.

method.comment: No redaction, so a restore keeps admin's password
The backup is a job: wait for it to finish

automation.description: Signs in as admin in SmartClient (desktop UX/UI), clears the completed jobs list again and backs up the data, checking that both backups are now listed.

interaction.name: Clear the completed jobs list again
interaction.description: Clears the completed jobs list again, so the PrimeFaces backup's row cannot be mistaken for the next one, and checks it is empty.

method.comment: Clear PrimeFaces' backup row too, so that the wait below is for this backup's job, and the 05-reports-misc.xml members find exactly one Backup row
SmartClient's testGridRows with a timeout fetches the list again until the count holds

interaction.name: Back up the data before the suite (SmartClient)
interaction.description: Starts the same backup in SmartClient, waits for the Backup job to complete, and checks the Backup/Restore list now shows both backups.

method.comment: No redaction, so a restore keeps admin's password
The job's "Backup Completed" push message, which can arrive at once, is added to this growl, not put in its place
The backup is a job: wait for it to finish
The SmartClient view has no Refresh Backup List button: testGridRows fetches the list again. Both backups are listed now.
